services.value: Alliance Technical Group provides environmental consulting and compliance support, including air quality services (air permitting, air compliance, air dispersion modeling, and compliance reporting), odor assessment services, and water quality services (hydrological & hydraulic studies, NPDES permitting, and stormwater). It also offers natural resources services (biological assessment, human health ecological risk assessment, and stream/wetland restoration and mitigation) and civil and environmental engineering (water, wastewater, and stormwater design), plus industrial process and surveying/mapping capabilities.
